findings.evidence: tests/test_early_private_reference_guard.py:348-355 calls integration._require_early_privacy(root). The call site at template/scripts/requirement_integration.py:828 sits before `if complete: _run_full_checks(root)`. Moving or removing that call would not fail any test. The design's Verification section promises ordering tests with sentinels.
findings.summary: The shared-publisher ordering guarantee (early guard before _run_full_checks, including draft candidates) is only tested by calling the private helper _require_early_privacy directly. No test drives publish_candidate to show the guard runs before full checks and before any publication.

findings.evidence: tests/test_early_private_reference_guard.py:326-331 vs the archive_change gate at template/scripts/openspec_lifecycle.py:539-544. All archive tests call lifecycle.archive_change(root, "work") with the default finalize=False.
findings.summary: The spec scenario 'Configured guard unavailable' says archive fails explicitly. The test covers only private_lineage.require_clean_candidate. It does not cover archive_change, so it does not check the SystemExit wrapping or that nothing proceeds. Coordinator finalization (finalize=True), which the spec requires to be covered, is also not exercised.
